summary: community.general removals: long internal FQCN redirects such as community.general.packaging.os.apt_rpm, ansible_galaxy_install ack options, cloudflare_dns SPF records, django_manage cleanup/syncdb/validate commands, the flowdock, stackdriver, webfaction and rax modules, DependencyMixin, proxmox_default_behavior, the Rhsm classes and the redhat_subscription autosubscribe alias.
questions: Why does community.general.packaging.os.apt_rpm no longer resolve?
Are the Rackspace rax modules still available?
Can I create SPF records with cloudflare_dns?
What do I use instead of autosubscribe in redhat_subscription?

answer_card.title: community.general removals in Ansible 10
answer_card.answer_md:
- Long internal FQCNs like `community.general.packaging.os.apt_rpm` no longer redirect. Use the short form `community.general.apt_rpm`.
- `django_manage`: `cleanup`, `syncdb`, `validate` removed. Use `clearsessions`, `migrate`, `check`.
- `cloudflare_dns`: SPF record support removed.
- Removed modules: `flowdock`, `stackdriver`, `webfaction_*`, and all `rax*` (pyrax).
- `redhat_subscription`: `autosubscribe` alias removed. Use `auto_attach`.
- `proxmox`: `proxmox_default_behavior` removed.
- `ansible_galaxy_install`: `ack_ansible29` and `ack_min_ansiblecore211` removed.
